import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customer } from "./customer";
import { rental } from "./rental";
import { staff } from "./staff";

export const payment = defineTable("payment", {
    columns: {
        paymentId: col.integer().primaryKey().dbDefault(),
        customerId: col.integer().notNull(),
        staffId: col.integer().notNull(),
        rentalId: col.integer().notNull(),
        amount: col.numeric(5, 2).notNull(),
        paymentDate: col.timestamptz().primaryKey(),
        uuid: col.uuid().notNull().defaultSql("uuidv7()")
    },
    relations: {
        customer: rel.belongsTo(() => customer, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        rental: rel.belongsTo(() => rental, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        staff: rel.belongsTo(() => staff, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
